{{dablink|For other uses of the word "winter," see [[Winter]].}}
'''The Winter Blossom''' is a respectable [[inn]] in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Winter Blossom, The}}

When [[Matrim Cauthon|Mat Cauthon]] returned to Ebou Dar, he stopped at The Winter Blossom. He didn't stay at the inn due to the large number of [[Deathwatch Guard]]s staying there, the presence of which caused him to worry that he might encounter [[Furyk Karede]].{{ref/book|14|11}}
